title: 16 Mahajanapada

facts.Srot: Anguttara Nikaya (Bauddh); Jain Bhagavati Sutra ki list alag

exam_points: Anga (Champa), Magadha (Rajagriha), Kashi (Varanasi), Kosala (Shravasti), Vajji (Vaishali), Malla (Kushinara, Pava).
